name: Li
source:
Born in a small town away from the big cities. Left her home to go to university. Lives in a rented flat. Joined the team immediately. Has many interests, easily makes new acquaintances. Not a star pupil, but her lecture notes are renowned for their accuracy and lack of blots.

[From the in-game profile]
